title: Generating realistic 3D hair from an image using AI
author: Electrobita
selftext: I went down a rabbit hole and found out about DiffLocks while trying to find a tool on how to generate realistic hair styles from just a reference image. I’d like to know if there’s other tools or ongoing research projects that aren’t named here, but these results from Meshcapade definitely caught my eye as it’s the newest project of its kind as far as I know

replies.body: No. That's the problem. All of this hair ai models are oddly specific. Even within realistic models, most cant do the whole range, I suppose bcs they didnt have enough hairstyles as it is expensive. They say they use thousands, but in reality is just a variation of a handful, so yeah, not veru useful, Even less for anime where placing and topology are Even more important
